title: Has Multimodal Learning Delivered Universal Intelligence in Healthcare? A Comprehensive Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review of performance disparities in medical AI, specifically noting how neural models trained on public chest X-ray datasets underdiagnose female patients.
Literature review of ethical concerns in healthcare AI, highlighting studies that show model underdiagnosis in marginalized communities, such as Black and Hispanic patients.
Review of disparities in model performance based on patient insurance status, specifically noting underdiagnosis in patients insured by Medicaid.
Review of cross-lingual medical vision-language pre-training methods (such as Med-UniC) that utilize text alignment regularization to neutralize community bias caused by different languages.

Analysis of multimodal model evaluation protocols, discussing how the demographic characteristics of human evaluators (such as race, sex, and age) can introduce unconscious biases into the manual assessment of generated outputs.
